{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

# Check for any commas in the revenue column
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Display those rows
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    print("Sample of rows with commas:")
    print(data[has_commas]['revenue'].head())
else:
    print("No commas found in revenue column.")"}
